description: The plot illustrates the relative change across different neural network layer groups for various token and bit-precision configurations, including LB-Avg and RULER4k metrics, compared to a baseline. The x-axis represents categorical layer groups, with discrete tick labels sequentially ordered as "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale with values expressed as percentages, ranging from -25% to 5%, with specific tick marks placed at -25%, -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. The plot contains five lines. The "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" is represented by a grey dashed line with no markers, remaining constant at exactly 0% across all layer groups. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers; it starts near 0% at Layer1-4, dips slightly to approximately -1.5% at Layer13-20, and ends slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" is depicted by a solid red line with square markers, starting at 0% at Layer1-4, reaching a low point of approximately -4.5% at Layer13-20, and recovering to roughly -0.5% at Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" is a solid light blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, experiencing a notable decline to roughly -12.5% at Layer13-20, and returning to approximately -1.5% at Layer29-32. Finally, the "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" is represented by a solid dark blue line with square markers; it starts at approximately -2.5% at Layer1-4, drops sharply to a minimum of -25% at Layer13-20, and rises to end at approximately -3% at Layer29-32.
